description: This file defines a SwiftUI View called RootTabs, which manages a tab-based user interface with three main tabs: Screen, Voice, and Settings. It also handles overlays such as status pills and toast notifications for voice wake commands, and integrates environment objects and user settings.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the main view layout with tab items, overlays for status and toasts, and reactive behavior to voice commands.

methods.name: gatewayStatus
methods.description: Computes the current status of the gateway for display in the status pill.

methods.name: statusActivity
methods.description: Builds context about ongoing activities, including camera and voice wake status.
